text: Tom Witzky, a phone lineman in working-class Chicago, lets his sister-in-law hypnotise him at a party and comes back [seeing things he cannot shut out|rules|it gets inside you]. Visions of a struggle draw him to Samantha Kozac, a trusting teenage girl who vanished from the neighbourhood months ago, while his young son Jake quietly talks with the dead. [Her spirit tells him to dig|wants|release and unfinished business], and Tom tears up the yard and the house until a basement wall gives way on [what the neighbours have hidden|wrong|the powerful abuse their power].
